caseNameFull: MASSACHUSETTS v. Stephen J. GRAY, Trustee in Bankruptcy of Newbury Cafe, Inc., dba 29 Newbury

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit. The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the First Circuit for further consideration in light of United States v. Ron Pair Enterprises, Inc., 489 U.S. -, 109 S.Ct. 1026, — L.Ed.2d-(1989).
